governance_scope: Post-R7.5.3 V1+ architecture-reset evidence only; R7.5.3 remains FAIL_BLOCKED_CLOSED.
interpretation: Holding the entire deal fixed leaves only modest traversal/action-sampling variance: pooled K1 regret-matching policy TV is about 0.052.
Holding the acting player's exact root SPNNIV3 observation fixed while changing hidden/future chance increases pooled K1 target-policy TV to about 0.515, roughly 9.9x the traversal-only value.
COMBINED is essentially the same scale as CHANCE_ONLY, so chance/deck realization is the dominant upstream source in this diagnostic.

Raw target averaging does reduce numeric target mean-absolute difference monotonically as K grows, but K4 does not reduce sign instability or regret-matching policy TV; therefore generic K4 continuation averaging is not justified for training.

The K4 failure does not imply chance variance is unimportant. It implies naive small-K averaging is not a sufficient remedy for a target distribution whose action advantages frequently lie near the regret-matching zero boundary.

Before any new training, the next diagnostic should hold chance support identical across the two frozen source behavior ensembles and directly measure residual cross-behavior target divergence. This distinguishes deck-support variance from feedback/policy-induced divergence on the same deals.
